notes: ACCESS: browser-only via Chrome tabs (mcp__claude-in-chrome__*). robots.txt checked first (https://www.article.com/robots.txt) - 'User-agent: *' with 'Allow: /' and only checkout/account/search/api paths disallowed; no Claude/AI-bot block found - proceeded. Homepage, /c/all-products, /browse/18/storage, /sitemap.xml and /category_sitemap.xml all loaded successfully before the block. TREE: built from union of (a) top nav (Rooms, Products, Outdoor, Decor, Furniture Collections, Best Sellers, New Arrivals, Bundles, Ideas & Inspiration, Article Pro, Sale), (b) the live /browse/18/storage page's own sub-nav strip (Dressers & Armoires, Sideboards & Cabinets, Media Units & Bookcases, Benches & Ottomans, Desks & File Cabinets, Shelves & Wall Mirrors - page confirmed live, h1 'Home Storage & Organization', 221 items total), and (c) category_sitemap.xml (dated 2022-09-20, still the only sitemap available) listing Decor subcategories: decor-lighting, decor-rugs, decor-poufs, decor-pillows, decor-throws, decor-accents, decor-mirrors, decor-care-products. BLOCK: clicking a Storage sub-nav 'Shop Dressers & Armoires' link led to a tag-filtered browse URL that returned a DataDome Human Verification page. Per the hard block-stop rule (first block = stop requesting that host, do not chase via another route), no further article.com pages were requested, including the Decor landing page itself. QTY: no per-subcategory quantity could be confirmed with page evidence before the block, so every leaf row below is qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than estimated/guessed. The one confirmed aggregate number (221 items on /browse/18/storage) was deliberately NOT used as a row value because that bucket mixes non-storage items (Desks = furniture, Wall Mirrors = decor) with genuine storage items - recording it would misstate quantity per the primary-purpose rule. EXCLUDED from Textile: decor-lighting (Lighting category, separate workbook), decor-poufs (pouf/ottoman = seating furniture boundary, not textile per rules Section 21), decor-accents (general decorative accents, Decorative-Home-Accessories scope), decor-mirrors (Wall Decor, not textile), decor-care-products (fabric/furniture care products - a cleaning product, not a textile product itself). EXCLUDED from Storage: 'Desks & File Cabinets' sub-nav bucket (desks are furniture-primary; File Cabinets could not be isolated from the combined bucket) and 'Shelves & Wall Mirrors' sub-nav bucket (Wall Mirrors are Wall Decor; Shelves could not be isolated). Product-type facet counts seen on /c/all-products (e.g. Area Rug 147, Bedding 36, Bedding Inserts 7, Bench 50, Bookcase 76) are informational only - no valid navigable category URL exists for a facet click (search/filter-result URLs are disallowed by the URL rule), so no rows were created from them. All recorded leaf rows use the null-qty + MANUAL REVIEW escape valve (Section 1 hard rule) rather than any fabricated or estimated number/URL.
